parole.significato: an honorific title given to Bektashi Dedebabas and chief masters of the Mevlevi Order.
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish چلبی (çelebi). Nominalization of the adjective çelebî (“respectful, mature”), from Çalap + -î. Etymology of the nominal part Çalap (“God, Allah”) (obsolete in Modern Turkish, cf. Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (çalap, “Allah”)), is unclear beyond Old Anatolian T
